CANARY EXECUTED AND VERIFIED — REB-341 (one light issue, human-approved remediation).

Backup taken BEFORE any deletion: backup/REB-341.json (83/83 comments, id + full ADF body + author accountId + displayName + created, 308,611 bytes), completeness-gated.

Result: 51 duplicates deleted (HTTP 204), 0 already-gone, 0 failed. REB-341 went 83 -> 32 comments.

Verified three independent ways:
1. Script post-verify: total_after=32, distinct_after=32, remaining_dupes=0, missing_bodies=[], unmarked unchanged at 0 -> PASS.
2. Independent diff of the live surviving set against the pre-deletion BACKUP file: 32/32 distinct normalized bodies present, 0 missing, 0 new, 0 duplicate survivors.
3. Independent count via acli 'jira workitem comment list --paginate': 32 — agrees with the REST fetch and Jira reported total.

Invariant holds: every distinct source comment retains exactly one instance. Proceeding to the remaining issues in ascending size order, REB-1861 LAST.
